title: Goodwill, void and vendor credits are not in the reports
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is Markup % 25.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for Part Sales in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A, with 5 units of a part in category A, cost $16.00 each, priced $20.00 each by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Make a $50.00 goodwill credit for customer A on the customer page.
  2. Return 1 unit from Part Sale 1 with no restocking fee.
  3. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  4. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
  5. Void the return's credit.
  6. Reload Sales by Tier.
  7. Open Reports › Sales By Customer.
  8. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The goodwill credit is made.

Step 2:

  • A $20.00 credit for the return is made.

Step 3:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 4:

  • Tier A's row reads Parts Credits −$20.00, the return only (1 × $20.00).
  • The $50.00 goodwill credit is not in any row.

Step 5:

  • The return's credit is void.

Step 6:

  • Tier A's row reads Parts Credits $0.00 again.
  • Parts Invoiced still reads $100.00.

Step 7:

  • Sales By Customer opens.

Step 8:

  • Customer A's row there shows the $50.00 goodwill credit.
